title.en: Automated building energy modeling for energy retrofits using a large language model-based multi-agent framework

paragraphs.en: Lu et al., iScience 28 (2025), article 113867. Data2BEM automates building energy modeling from heterogeneous documents, sensor data and user instructions through calibration and retrofit assessment. The stated gap is fragmented geometry, parameterization, calibration and assessment tools. No numbered hypothesis list is presented.

GPT-4-based Information Retriever, Programmer, Result Analyzer, Interpreter and Reviewer agents exchange structured information and code. CAD/DXF geometry, specifications, schedules and sensor data become JSON, OpenStudio code and an EnergyPlus model. Human review remains part of the workflow.
paragraphs.fa: بازیاباطلاعات،برنامه‌نویس،تحلیل‌گرنتیجه،مفسر وبازبین مبتنیبرGPT-4پارامترساختاریافته،کدOpenStudio،خروجی وگزارش مبادله می‌کنند.CAD/DXF،اسنادHVAC،برنامه ومصرفاندازه‌گیری‌شدهورودی‌اند.OpenStudio/EnergyPlusشبیه‌سازیعددیراانجام می‌دهندوکاربرحضور دارد.

paragraphs.en: Calibration uses 2018 heating measurements and a genetic algorithm with population 100, 20 generations, crossover probability 0.5 and mutation probability 0.2. Parameters and bounds are retrieved or confirmed before model runs. External numerical simulation evaluates candidates; the language model does not replace the building physics solver.

The real-building case evaluates geometry, heating-system modeling, schedules, simulation configuration, calibration and a boiler-to-air-source-heat-pump retrofit. Two modelers with six months and four years of experience require 32 and 8 hours, respectively, versus 48 minutes for Data2BEM. Prompt-style perturbations are tested; detailed supplementary traces are referenced but not included in the local PDF.

paragraphs.en: Calibration reports NMBE 2.91%, CV-RMSE 0.139 and R² 0.972. The simulated retrofit reduces energy cost from 16,164.25 to 9,026.32 (44.16%) and carbon tax from 7,813.19 to 1,621.49. These are model-based retrofit estimates, not measured savings after installation.

Validation concerns one richly documented building. Detailed room control and continuous updates are not tested; calibration is offline, the genetic algorithm is not universally suitable and peak-load discrepancies remain. The paper reports code at Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17374005, while operational and design data are private. Real-time Twin adaptation remains future work.

importance.en: Agentic generation and calibration of building models already exist. This is relevant to Twin-update engineering and to defining what our causal intervention contribution adds.

contribution.en: It contributes structured retrieval, coding and review interfaces plus an external simulation and calibration workflow.

employment.en: Adapt versioned calibration proposals and a reviewer interface in the isolated Operational Twin sandbox. Keep the Reference Twin frozen and require diagnostic evidence before accepting parameter changes. This is our proposed use, not an evaluated article result.
employment.fa: رابطپیشنهادکالیبراسیوننسخه‌داروبازبین درsandboxTwinعملیاتی اقتباس شود؛Twinمرجع ثابتماندوتغییرپارامترشاهدتشخیصی بخواهد.

baseline.en: Use as a modeling and calibration helper rather than a mandatory control or diagnosis baseline. A calibration-workflow comparison is optional if input data and task scope can be matched.

critical.en: The 48-minute comparison with two modelers is case-specific. Calibration fit does not identify equipment fault causes or prove measured post-retrofit recovery.

key_results.en: Calibration NMBE 2.91%, CV-RMSE 0.139, R² 0.972; modeling 48 minutes; simulated ASHP energy cost −44.16%.

coverage_notes.en: Source text, original figure/table pages and bibliography inspected. Original source-page views preserve the complete graphics when individual crops are uncertain. Printed values only; no curve digitization. Project relevance and baseline recommendations are explicitly reviewer assessments. Supplementary material not supplied with the local PDF is not claimed reviewed.

data.en: Printed highlights report modeling-time reduction >90% (48 minutes versus 8–32 hours), simulated energy cost reduction about 44% and carbon tax roughly fivefold lower. These summarize the main case and are not independent replications.
